translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: Nhing'hano ako Yelusalemu
Wanhu wanji nawafika Antiokiya wolawila Yudeya nawaluka kuwalangusa wala wanhu wa lukolo lumwe wolonga, “Wone hamwinjile ikumbi kota mabochelo vyoyalajize Musa, hamloholigwa.”

Mbuli ayi nayambuza kitwanza ng'hatu, Paoli na Banaba lowalongase na hewo, yamulilwa Paoli na Banaba hamwe na vilongozi wa ng'handa ya Nguluwi ya Antiokiya walute Yelusalemu kuwona wala watumigwa na wasekulu kulapa mbuli ayo.

Wala wanhu nawawalaga, na hewo lowali wokolela Foinike na Samaliya nawawalonjela wanhu hawawele Wayahudi vyowamgalamchile Nguluwi. Mbuli azo ziwasangalaza ng'hatu chila chilundo cha wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu cheng'ha.
Lowafichile Yelusalemu nawabocheligwa na chilundo cha wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu, watumigwa na wasekulu, na hewo nawawalonjela gala geng'ha Nguluwi vyoyaditile hamwe na hewo.
Ila wanhu wamwe walingumkunda Kilistu wali wa chilundo cha Mafalisayo nawema, walonga, “Iwagana wanhu hawawele Wayahudi wenjile ikumbi na kulanguswa kota malajizo ga Musa vyogalingulonga.”
Lelo watumigwa na wasekulu wadita nhing'hano ya kulola mbuli ayo.

Lowataguse lukami, Petili nakema, kalonga, “Wang'holozangu, hemwe mvizela kota aho ha mwaluko Nguluwi nakanyhagula heni hali hemwe ndamle Mbuli Inojile kwa wanhu hawawele Wayahudi, wahuliche na kukunda.
Na heye Nguluwi yazizelele nhumbula za wanhu, nakatawiza kota kawakunda kwa kuwapa na hewo Muhe Yelile kota vyoyatupele hetwe.
Haditile ubagulo woneche mli hetwe na hewo, nakadita nhumbula za hewo ziwe zelile kwa vila nawamkunda Yesu.
Lelo lekachoni kumjeza Nguluwi kwa kuwadwika awo walanguswa mhomholo ne wasekulu ne hetwe natulemwela kupapa?
Ileche kuwa ahyo, leka hetwe twangukunda kota, hetwe kota hila hewo, toloholigwa kukolela igano lya Mkulu Yesu.”
Chilundo cheng'ha nachikala tulu, nachiwahulichiza Banaba na Paoli wolonga ulajilo wa vinduzanduza na kububuwaza Nguluwi vyoyaditile hali wanhu hawawele Wayahudi.
Lowasindile kulonga, Yakubu nakaluka kulonga, “Wang'holozangu mhulichize!
Simoni nakalonga hila Nguluwi aho mwaluko vyoyali yowahangawila wanhu hawawele Wayahudi, nakahagula wanhu wamwe wawe wanhu wa heye.
Mbuli ayi iwhana ng'hatu na ulonzi wa waloli wa Nguluwi, kota Maandiko Matakatifu vyogalingulonga,

content.text: na kuzenga kahi chibumuli cha Daudi chigwile,
ndogongomanya kahi mahame ga heye na kuzenga kahi.
wanhu wa isi yeng'ha ndiwachemile wawe wa heni,
Ahyo ndo vyoyalingulonga Mkulu, yaditile chinhu achi chizeleche kulawila katali.’ ”

content: Yakubu nakalutilila kulonga, “Ahyo, kwamula kwa heni ndo aku, tuleche kuwagaza wanhu wali ngumgalamchila Nguluwi,

ila tuwahilichile lyandiko kuwalonjela waleche kulya vilyo vikokomoche kwa kutambichilwa vimalukolo vya milungu, miyuse na ung'hondwa, waleche kulya miwunde joneche jipobosolwe na waleche kunwa danda.
Mina kwa Mhela uhejile, ulonzi wa Musa lwali ludamligwa kuli chila honhu na kusomigwa muli ng'handa za kusalila zeng'ha za Wayahudi chila Zuwa lya Kwesela.”
Lyandiko kwa wanhu hawawele Wayahudi

Watumigwa na wasekulu, hamwe na weng'ha wa chilundo cha wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu, nachigana kuwahagula wanhu wamwenga mli hewo na kuwalajiza Antiokiya hamwe na Paoli na Banaba. Wamhagula Yudasi yalinguchemigwa Balisaba na Sila, wala nawazeleche ng'hatu hali hewo.
Wawapa lyandiko ali, “Hetwe watumigwa na wasekulu, wang'holozenu, twanguwalamsani hemwe muwele wanhu hawawele Wayahudi muwele ako Antiokiya na Siliya na Kilikiya.

Natuhulika kota wanhu wanji walawile aku kwa hetwe wakuwifyani kwa ulonzi wa hewo, nawazidita nhumbula za hemwe ziwe na lunhwinhwi. Ila nawadita ahyo ne kukundizwa na munhu yoneche kulawila kwa hetwe.
Ahyo tweng'ha hamwe tugana kuwahagula wanhu wamwe na kuwalajiza kwa hemwe, hamwe na wala tuwaganile hetwe Banaba na Paoli,
wala wambuze ukomu wa hewo kwa itagwa lya Mkulu wa hetwe Yesu Kilistu.
Ahyo twanguwalajiza Yudasi na Sila kwa hemwe, hewo wokulonjelani wawo aga gotwandiche.
Muhe Yelile na hetwe tukunda tuleche kuwadwika mhomolo zinji ila azi zitanganiche,
mleche kulya vilyo vitambichilwe na jimalukolo, mleche kunwa danda, mleche kulya miwunde ja migongolo jipobosolwe, na miyuse na ung'hondwa. Mowa mditile goya wone mleche kudita mbuli azo. Malumbo!”
Lowawalajile, awo wasenga nawaluta Antiokiya kula nawachema nhing'hano ya wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu, nawawapa alila lyandiko.
Lowasomile ago gandichigwe, ulonzi wandikwe nauwapa nhumbula ikangale, nawasangalala ng'hatu.
Yudasi na Sila, wala na hewo wali waloli wa Nguluwi, nawalongasa na awo wanhu kwa mhela uhejile wowasindamiza nhumbula na kuwemiza.
Lowekale ako hado hela, wanhu wa Antiokiya nawawalaga wowaganila kikala goya, hamba nawahiluka kwa wawatumile.
Ila Sila nakapona kumbele.
Paoli na Banaba nawapona ako Antiokiya mhela uhejile, wolangusa na kudamla mbuli ulonzi wa Mkulu, hamwe na wanhu wanji wenji.
Paoli na Banaba wangibagula
Mazuwa mado logapulute, Paoli nakamlonjela Banaba, “Tuhiluche tukawajendele wala wanhu chila muji hala hotudamle ulonzi wa Mkulu, tikalolele twetwe vyowalingulutilila.”
Banaba nakagana wamhole na Yohani yalinguchemigwa Malichi.
Ila Paoli nahaganile wamhole Yohani Malichi, ayula ako hamwaluko nakawaleka kula Pamfiliya na kulema kitanza mli mijito ja hewo.
Lelo nakulawila kitwanza wawo yeng'ha, nawalekana. Banaba nakamhola Yohani Malichi, nawakwina meli kuza Kupulo.
Ila Paoli nakamhagula Sila, hala wanhu wa honhu aho howamuwichile hasi hali udimo wa kunoga kwa heye Mkulu, koka.
Paoli na miyage Sila nawaluta ako Siliya na Kilikiya, wokangaza nhumbula za chilundo cha wanhu walingumkunda Kilistu.
